title: Slate Composition Format (SCF)
description: JSON schema for Slate video compositions. The agent generates SCF documents; the HyperFrames renderer (via the SCF→HTML compiler) consumes them.

pipeline.description: Pipeline type that produced this composition

brandPackage.description: Name of the Brand Package to apply, optionally pinned to a version (e.g. 'contoso' or 'contoso@2.1'). When unpinned in non-draft profiles, a lint warning is emitted; pinning is mandatory for deliveryProfile in {external, executive, regulated}.

brandPackageHash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the resolved Brand Package YAML at render time. Persisted into the render audit trail for reproducibility.

brandPackageSource.description: Provenance of the resolved Brand Package (e.g. 'config/org/brand-packages/contoso.yaml@<git-sha>').

brandLintPassed.description: Result of the most recent brand-package-linting run against this SCF. PR 5 emits this as informational; PR 9 will hard-gate external deliveryProfiles on brandLintPassed === true.

scenes.description: Ordered list of scenes in the video

metadata.description: Agent-generated metadata (cost estimate, tool versions, etc.)

deliveryProfile.description: Audience class for this render. Drives governance gates: brandPackage version pinning is mandatory for {external, executive, regulated}; demo-data-classifier findings are treated as warnings in PR 5 but will hard-block external profiles in PR 9.

component.description: Pre-built component name (e.g., BrandIntro, BrandOutro, TitleCard)

layers.description: Layer stack for custom scenes (bottom to top)

narration.description: Path to narration audio file for this scene

narrationText.description: Exact narration text paired with the narration audio for validation, review, and caption governance

narrationStartSec.description: Offset in seconds from scene start before narration audio begins

notes.description: Agent's notes about creative intent for this scene

_demoDataWaiver.description: Explicit waiver for demo-data-classifier findings on this scene. Required to silence high-severity findings under non-draft deliveryProfiles in PR 9; informational only in PR 5.

src.description: Path to media file (for image/video/caption layers; REQUIRED for lottie — points at a self-contained Lottie JSON file relative to the project root, loaded at COMPILE time and embedded as animationData. Runtime path-loading is forbidden by PR 9 Rule #10.)

loop.description: lottie only — loop the animation when the master timeline cursor exceeds the embedded duration.

segment.description: lottie only — optional [fromFrame, toFrame] subsegment to play.

x.description: lottie only — absolute container x in scene px (default 0).

y.description: lottie only — absolute container y in scene px (default 0).

width.description: lottie only — container width in scene px (default = scene width).

height.description: lottie only — container height in scene px (default = scene height).

style.description: Style preset name or text style object

component.description: Registered Slate component name for component layers

props.description: Props passed to a component layer

zIndex.description: Layer stacking order; higher values render above lower values

endTime.description: End time within scene (seconds). Default: scene duration

props.description: Props passed to a component-backed boundary transition.

duck_on_narration.description: Reduce music volume when narration is playing

loop.description: Loop music if video is longer than track

font.description: Font family (brand-primary uses Brand Package font)

color.description: Caption text color (hex or brand token)

highlightBackgroundColor.description: Active word highlight background. Used per-word, not as a full caption box.

backgroundColor.description: Caption panel background color. Ignored unless panel is true; distributed captions should keep this transparent.

lineBackgroundColor.description: Per-line contrast surface used for active-line captions so white text stays readable over bright footage.

panel.description: When false, captions render as one active transcript line at a time, not as a paragraph. Set true only for an explicit boxed caption panel.

timingOffsetSec.description: Global caption timing offset in seconds. Positive values delay active rows and word highlights when transcription timestamps feel slightly early.

PricingTableProps.description: Props for the PricingTable component (PR 3, Sales / GBB seller-narrative).

CompetitiveMatrixProps.description: Props for the CompetitiveMatrix component (PR 3, Sales / GBB seller-narrative). MUST supply at least one of `disclaimer` or `footnotes`/`footnotesJson` (source attribution).

CustomerStoryProps.description: Props for the CustomerStory component (PR 3, Sales / GBB proof-point).

ROICalculatorProps.description: Props for the ROICalculator component (PR 3, Sales / GBB business-case).

RoadmapProps.description: Props for the Roadmap component (PR 4, PM/EM swimlane roadmap).

BurnDownProps.description: Props for the BurnDown component (PR 4, sprint burn-down with plan/actual/forecast).

OKRStatusProps.description: Props for the OKRStatus component (PR 4, objective + key-result snapshot).

ReleaseNotesProps.description: Props for the ReleaseNotes component (PR 4, release digest with features/fixes/breaking-changes).

QuizProps.description: Props for the Quiz component (PR 6, single-answer Q&A with reveal). PR 6 supports mode='single' only.

TerminologyCardProps.description: Props for the TerminologyCard component (PR 6, glossary card with definition + analogy + 'do not confuse with').

ProgressBarProps.description: Props for the ProgressBar component (PR 6, segmented chapter orientation). Precedence: completionPct overrides derived progress; invalid weights default to 1; unknown currentSectionId degrades to first section.

TerminalCastProps.description: Props for the TerminalCast component (PR 6, cinematic terminal with zoom/pan + branding). Standalone — does NOT inherit from TerminalScene.

PresenterBugProps.description: Props for the PresenterBug component (PR 6, compact speaker-identity bug for live broadcast feel).

EventBrandingProps.description: Props for the EventBranding component (PR 6, event opener/bumper/lower-frame). 'date' is display text (e.g. 'May 6–8, 2026'), not ISO.

themeArtLottieSrc.description: Optional path to a self-contained Lottie JSON file used as animated background instead of themeArtSrc.

AskTheAudienceProps.description: Props for the AskTheAudience component (PR 6, live-poll bars/donut). Winner = highest pct, tiebreak by count, otherwise no winner ring.

background.description: CSS color or image URL for the scene background

logoSrc.description: Path or URL to the logo image

sparklinePoints.description: SVG polyline points for the sparkline graphic

ComponentOverlayProps.description: Props for ComponentOverlay, a generic transparent host for rich component overlays.

MetricStackProps.description: Props for MetricStack, a three-card animated KPI stack.

BookPageMetricsProps.description: Props for BookPageMetrics, an editorial book spread with metric tiles.

pageImage.description: Optional page/background image composited into the paper texture.

overlay.description: Optional nested overlay component rendered on top of the page.

PALReviewSurfaceProps.description: Props for PALReviewSurface, an Azure DevOps-style PAL data-contract PR review surface.

stepsHtml.description: Legacy playback steps HTML injected into the editor area

filename.description: Active file name shown in tab and explorer tree

language.description: Language identifier for syntax highlighting context

statusbarText.description: Legacy: space-separated status-bar items (transformer splits on whitespace)

titlebar.description: Text shown in the terminal title bar

linesHtml.description: Raw HTML for terminal output lines with animation data attributes

tabsHtml.description: Raw HTML for the tab strip

src.description: URL or path to the content displayed inside the frame

urlBar.description: URL text shown in the browser address bar

windowTitle.description: Title text for macOS-style window chrome

scale.description: Scale factor for the frame within the scene

tileColumns.description: Number of tile columns in the shatter grid.

tileRows.description: Number of tile rows in the shatter grid.

color.description: CSS color for the tile fill and reveal background.

incomingImageSrc.description: Optional image path revealed behind the shattered tiles.

spreadFactor.description: Multiplier for how far tiles travel when shattering.

outgoingColor.description: CSS color fallback for outgoing layer.

incomingColor.description: CSS color fallback for incoming layer.

flashColor.description: CSS color for the midpoint flash.

flashDuration.description: Duration of the midpoint flash in seconds.

outgoingColor.description: CSS color for the outgoing layer.

incomingColor.description: CSS color for the incoming layer.

brandColor.description: CSS color for the radial vortex bands.

bandCount.description: Number of radial bands in the vortex.

vortexRotation.description: Total rotation in degrees for the vortex effect.

direction.description: Which edge acts as the page hinge.

outgoingSrc.description: Optional path or URL for the outgoing face artwork.

incomingSrc.description: Optional path or URL for the incoming face artwork.

frontLabel.description: Small label on the outgoing page face.

backLabel.description: Small label on the revealed face.

frontSubtitle.default: A tactile bridge that folds the outgoing moment into the next chapter.
frontSubtitle.description: Supporting copy for the outgoing face.

backSubtitle.default: The incoming scene arrives on the reverse side, already waiting behind the sheet.
backSubtitle.description: Supporting copy for the revealed face.

paperTint.description: Base tint for the paper stock.

accentColor.description: Accent color used in the incoming badge.

outgoingSrc.description: Optional path or URL for the outgoing scene artwork.

incomingSrc.description: Optional path or URL for the incoming scene artwork.

headline.description: Large headline shown while the rainbow bands sweep.

subline.default: Color bands sweep through frame, then collapse into a single unified scene.

focalPoint.description: Center point for the iris close/open, expressed as '<x>% <y>%'.

outgoingSrc.description: Optional path or URL for the outgoing scene artwork.

incomingSrc.description: Optional path or URL for the incoming scene artwork.

outgoingLabel.description: Small label shown on the outgoing scene.

incomingLabel.description: Small label shown on the revealed scene.

subline.default: The outgoing scene contracts into a precise focal point before the next image blooms open.
subline.description: Shared supporting copy for both states.

color.description: CSS color for the comet and trail particles

trailCount.description: Number of trailing particles behind the comet

color.description: CSS accent color for the edge frame at the flip midpoint
CSS color for the monospace text characters

cursorColor.description: CSS color for the blinking cursor

cols.description: Number of columns in the character grid

rows.description: Number of rows in the character grid

deleteOffset.description: Milliseconds offset between delete and retype waves

assembledImageSrc.description: Transparent PNG/SVG assembled at the end of the particle converge.
